get.description: Cab catalogue and configured tariff estimates. Fresh MFA and cabs.read required; writes additionally cabs.manage (preview is read). Suppliers/categories/services use kind-specific content. Versioned writes and actor-scoped create replay, atomic immutable history/audit. Directional endpoint and full trip-window checks, current active supplier/category and party/distance constraints. Exact paise distance ceiling plus waiting/per-trip fees. Estimates exclude taxes/tolls/parking and do not confirm availability. No supplier booking, cancellation, rescheduling, actual charge or reconciliation adapter is configured.

Room/hold/actions/reconciliation require hotels.manage; plans require pricing; bulk calendar requires both. Ten-minute database-time holds share room capacity across all plans. Multi-night all-or-nothing allocation; expired holds excluded without cleanup; retries never extend expiry. Date endpoints are exclusive and use IST nights. Manual reconciliation records observations without changing inventory. No channel manager is configured.
